description: Breakdown of each ingredient in the m_p = T1+T2+T3+T4 tower derivation into FORMAL, CONJECTURAL, ASSUMED, or INPUT.  Uses the SDP-derived neutron gluon tail (σ₀σ₁σ₁σ₀, not 2σ₀).

provenance.name: q_0 substrate parameter
provenance.note: 1.1099785956; CODATA-bounded to ~1 ppb via m_μ/m_e ratio (see q_pinning_50_digit.py)

provenance.name: H_A = q − 1/q
provenance.note: Hecke relation parameter; follows from q_0 exactly

provenance.name: Wedderburn decomposition H_3(q) = sym ⊕ std ⊕ alt
Per-generator chain for B_3 confinement: (σ_0 σ_1^{-1})^3
provenance.note: Paper claim (rem:borromean-baryon): 3-quark confinement ≡ Borromean rings.  Structural, not proven from QCD.

provenance.name: Quark-pair crossing types: uu=(1,0), dd=(1,−H), ud=(1,−H/2)
provenance.note: User note: 'no convention. comes from SDP'.  Integer-LP feasibility (integer-lp-gluon.py, atom_braid_sdp_gluon.py) picks uu=σ, dd=σ⁻¹, ud=(σ+σ⁻¹)/2 as the Gram-positive solution.

provenance.name: Gluon tail: proton = 2·σ₀, neutron = σ₀σ₁σ₁σ₀ (NOT 2·σ₀)
provenance.note: atom_braid_sdp_gluon.py — naive 2·σ₀ for neutron fails the Gram-positivity constraint; L₊ L₋ = σ₀σ₁σ₁σ₀ is the feasible optimum.  Paper's original tower used 2·σ₀ for BOTH.

provenance.name: V̂_i^full = w_sym λ^sym_i + w_std V^std_i + w_alt λ^alt_i
provenance.note: Transfer-matrix representation of the 2×2 std block (Hoefsmit); recurrence in vertex_volume()

provenance.name: |V̂_i| operation
provenance.note: Absolute value of a signed real; no derivation that |·| is the correct nonlinearity.  Could be max(0,·) or similar.

provenance.name: Tower structure: m = |Π V̂_i| + Σ_i Φ_q(|V̂_i|) + z² Σ_{|i−j|=1} Φ_q(|V̂_i V̂_j|)
provenance.note: prop:mass-endomorphism-tower — paper proposes this shape; proof in content/ sketches jet-tower ascension via pentagon identity.  Not fully rigorous.

provenance.name: Restriction to pairs |i−j|=1 (adjacent only)
provenance.note: docs/locality-proof-attempt.md — far-commuting locality is PROVED via Kohno–Drinfeld; adjacent-locality claim is O(ℏ_q²) ≈ 1% which is the frontier.
